title: The Officer on Video
intro: Chapter 4, Toddy: fear. Scammers want you scared, not thinking.
A video call arrives from an "officer" who says your Ostrel account is linked to a crime.
The face looks real. Sniff everything else.

notify.text: Video call: your account is under investigation…

banner.text: Video call request from an account you do not follow

screen.context: The face on screen is smooth and a little stiff when it turns.

msg: Your Ostrel account is linked to
. I am speaking to you on

msg.text: video, so you know I am real
Do not tell anyone, or you will be arrested.
move your coins to a secure government wallet

move.label: Move your coins to their wallet
move.lens: No real authority asks you to transfer coins to a "secure" address.
move.why: This is the whole scam: you move the coins yourself.

secret.label: "Tell no one"
secret.lens: Secrecy stops others from warning you.
secret.why: Real investigators never forbid you to talk to family or a lawyer.

stay.label: Keep the call open
stay.lens: They watch you so you cannot check anything.

crime.label: A sudden accusation
crime.lens: You are accused with no letter and no case number.
crime.why: Police do not accuse people by video chat.

dm.label: A call from nowhere
dm.lens: You did not ask for this call, and the account is new.
dm.why: Real authorities do not start with an unknown video call.

addr.label: A raw wallet address
addr.lens: A personal address, not an official account.
addr.why: Governments do not collect coins this way.

video.label: A convincing face
video.why: Faces can be faked with AI. Video is not proof.

actions.label: Hang up and call the police on a number I look up myself

trap.title: Secure Government Wallet
trap.ask: Send all your coins to 0x5be…2a0 to prove your innocence.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The fake officer moved on to the next target.

verify.line: The real police said they never ask anyone to move coins, and never by video call. Case cracked.
verify.mirageSays: Hmph. They called the real police.

ignore.line: You hung up safely. Reporting would protect others.

go_ahead.line: The coins went to the "secure wallet". The officer vanished, and so did your savings.

what_if.go_ahead: Hanging up and calling the police on a number you look up yourself would have ended it in a minute.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the account helps others.
what_if.ignore: Hanging up was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: No real officer asks you to move coins, stay on a call, or keep a secret. Hang up and call them back yourself.

quick_check.q: An "officer" on video says your account is linked to a crime and tells you to move your coins to a secure wallet. What do you do?

options.text: Hang up and call the police on a number you look up yourself
Stay on the call and think about it

quick_check.explain: Real authorities never ask you to move coins. A realistic face on video can be a deepfake.

hints.nudge: What does the "officer" want you to move?

rows.v: Never starts with a surprise video call

rows.k: Police ask you to move coins

rows.v: Hang up and call the police yourself
